fact: The Independent reports Uganda's ICT Ministry seeking UGX 92 billion to assign addresses to all locations and link them to the national ID database, and says house numbering, street naming and postal codes are already happening in Uganda.

The Ministry of ICT's draft National Postcode and Addressing System Policy says a pilot in Entebbe Municipality installed road signage and house labels, and that the national address database is still to be established.
Kampala Capital City Authority launched its City Address Model, and its records show over 340,000 properties given house numbers and over 7,500 roads named (CIO Africa).
